response: No, homemade alcohol (Raksi) is not suitable for preserving dead bodies. While alcohol can be used as a preservative, the type and concentration of alcohol, as well as the method of application, are critical factors in effective preservation. Homemade alcohol, such as Raksi, may not have the required concentration or purity to prevent decay and decomposition, and its use could potentially lead to further deterioration of the body. Formaldehyde or other specialized preservatives are typically used in funeral homes and mortuaries for embalming and preserving dead bodies.
